<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Letter automation and task assignment failures",
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot reliably automate correspondence or trigger task assignments due to missing features and insufficient default settings. This forces manual handling of letters and causes significant delays in claim processing."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>

 },

 "renewals_90d_n": 2,
 "accounts": [

   "mentions": 1

   "mentions": 2
  },
  {

   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "127684fae8dcc625",
  "quote": "we’ve had issues with supplier letters not triggering automatically, and it’s causing delays in task assignments.",
  "account": "Thistlecombe Mutual",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-26T11:42:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "69b502589e4937ca",
  "quote": "can we discuss how policyholders receive automated letters? Some aren’t getting them.",
  "account": "Saltmarsh Specialty",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-26T14:35:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "928f645054451436",
  "quote": "are tasks auto-assigned when letters go out to policyholders? We’re seeing delays.",
  "account": "Saltmarsh Specialty",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-26T14:35:00Z"
 },
 {

 },

 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users cannot reliably automate correspondence or trigger task assignments because of missing features and insufficient default settings. This forces manual handling of letters and causes significant delays in claim processing.

## Who is affected

- Thistlecombe Mutual, where supplier letters are not triggering automatically and task assignments are being delayed [i:127684fae8dcc625].
- Saltmarsh Specialty, which reports that some policyholders are not receiving automated letters and that tasks are not auto-assigned when letters go out [i:69b502589e4937ca] [i:928f645054451436].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, which is handling correspondence manually and wants letters generated automatically based on claim status [i:bd374de2573473a9].
- Elderfold Home, which has tried to automate letters and hit a wall with the current defaults [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].

Across these 4 accounts there are 5 mentions, all on the sales route, representing 4290000.0 GBP in ARR [i:127684fae8dcc625] [i:69b502589e4937ca] [i:928f645054451436] [i:bd374de2573473a9] [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].

## Evidence

- Thistlecombe Mutual (980000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2027-09-01) reports issues with supplier letters not triggering automatically, causing delays in task assignments [i:127684fae8dcc625].
- Saltmarsh Specialty (740000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2027-05-15) asks how policyholders receive automated letters, noting some are not getting them [i:69b502589e4937ca].
- Saltmarsh Specialty also asks whether tasks are auto-assigned when letters go out to policyholders, and reports delays [i:928f645054451436].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (2400000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2027-01-15) asks whether letters can be generated automatically based on claim status, describing manual correspondence as overwhelming [i:bd374de2573473a9].
- Elderfold Home (170000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2026-12-21) has been trying to automate those letters and hit a wall with the current defaults [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].
- All 5 mentions across the 4 accounts came through the sales route, and 2 renewals fall within 90 days [i:127684fae8dcc625] [i:69b502589e4937ca] [i:928f645054451436] [i:bd374de2573473a9] [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].

## Why now

- 2 renewals fall within 90 days, including Elderfold Home on 2026-12-21 and Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15 [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b] [i:bd374de2573473a9].
- The affected accounts represent 4290000.0 GBP in ARR, with Hollinbrook Home Insurance alone at 2400000.0 GBP [i:bd374de2573473a9].
- The reported issues span 4 accounts and 5 mentions, all raised through the sales route [i:127684fae8dcc625] [i:69b502589e4937ca] [i:928f645054451436] [i:bd374de2573473a9] [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].
", "citations": ["127684fae8dcc625", "69b502589e4937ca", "928f645054451436", "bd374de2573473a9", "ccd44b8a2420af4b"]}
